items.title: Trump tells the UN that AI will now be called "super intelligence"
items.summary: At the UN General Assembly, Trump said "artificial" makes AI sound fake, so it would now be SI, and the State Department told diplomats to use it. X riffed on the initials: Sports Illustrated, "sí" and metric units.
